limitations: OSM geometry and recorded direction/access/turn rules are checked. Turns, two-stage scooter boxes and temporary regulations still require field survey.
School stops occur on the public eastbound side of Chaiqiao Road. School queues, short stop position, signal cycles and traffic volumes are simulation scenarios.
Freeway speed tags are copied where recorded; null means no numeric OSM value. Missing lane counts retain null; untagged widths, heights and bridge profiles are schematic.
Elevation profile is smoothed regional terrain elevation from the shared DEM in meters above sea level, not an engineering survey of pavement or tunnel grades.

The southbound departure and northbound arrival fronts on Guanxin Road are opposite public carriageways northeast of the Tokyo Midtown landmark. The car uses the park-side Hsinchu entrance to National Freeway 1, connecting to 3 towards Jiadong.
Nearby OSM objects are sampled within about 360 m and capped for browser performance.
